Commentary.Commentary: The Australian bowlers had to sweat hard. Pat Cummins was the standout performer with the ball and always tested the Indian batsmen with his raw pace and smart variations. The rest of the bowling attack did a decent job but never looked like picking a wicket. Their spinners were a major disappointment, although O'Keefe bagged a 3-fer, he was not at all penetrative. Now, the advantage is with India and Australia will have to bat exceedingly well from hereon. Stay tuned as they will be out soon to begin their second innings...

What a great batting performance by India! They were in a spot of bother at one stage after their openers had provided an excellent platform. After losing Kohli, Rahane and Nair cheaply, the 199-run partnership between Pujara and Saha saved the day for the home team. The former played a herculean knock while the wicketkeeper batsman once again quietly hit a century when the chips were down. The lower order also added handy runs, with a quickfire fifty by Jadeja and India ended up gaining a 152-run lead.
FOUR! Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Jadeja turns inside the crease and nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Kohli calls his players back and INDIA DECLARE ON 603/9!
Bouncer down the leg side, Jadeja allows it through to the keeper.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.
Cummins bounces back with a yorker in the blockhole, Jadeja digs it out.
Ravindra Jadeja brings up his 6th Test fifty.

FOUR! Fifty for Ravindra Jadeja and once again he celebrates like a warrior! Fuller and on middle, Jadeja whips it across the line and sends it blazing to the wide long on fence. He celebrates and Kohli is all smiles in the dressing room.
Full and down the leg side, Jadeja tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to Wade.
Flatter and outside off, skidding through, Ishant gets forward to defend but is beaten.
Flighted on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, pressed forward in defense.
Slow loopy full ball on off, Sharma gets well forward and defends it back.
Ishant Sharma is the last man in.

OUT! SOK gets his third wicket. Loopy full ball around off, Yadav comes down the track to go over Warner at mid off but fails to get the timing right. He ends up giving a straightforward catch and walks to the pavilion. India lead by 144!
Loopy full ball on off, Yadav gets forward and defends it.
Digs in a short ball around off, Yadav initially looks to duck but then pulls it at the last moment to deep square leg for one.
Full and tailing into the batsman, Yadav falls over a bit on the off side as he keeps it out to short mid-wicket.
50-run stand comes up between Ravindra Jadeja and Umesh Yadav. India lead by 143 runs.
EDGY FOUR! Fuller in length and outside off, Umesh tries to drive through covers but it catches a thick outside edge and runs wide of Smith at second slip for a boundary.
Bouncer around leg, Umesh ducks underneath it.
FOUR! Short in length and outside off, Yadav doesn't try to hit it hard and just steers it through backward point for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Pat Cummins is back on.
Kuldeep Yadav is out with drinks and probably with a message. Declaration round the corner?
Fullish on off, defended back.
SIX! Jadeja is having fun! Jadeja wears his skates to come down the track and launches it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Fuller and on off, Jadeja goes hard at it and gets it away off the inside edge to long leg. A couple of runs taken.

Appeal for an lbw! SOK senses the charge from the batsman and fires it quicker outside off, Jadeja is beaten and Wade takes the bails off. The third umpire is referred and the replays found Jadeja inside the crease. Wade was too slow.
Short and wide outside off, Jadeja cuts it to deep point and takes a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. No run.
SIX! Good clean hit! Flighted and on off, Jadeja skips down the track and hammers it over the bowler's head for a maximum.

Appeal for an lbw! A slider landing around off, skidding in, Jadeja gets forward to defend with his bat and pad together. Lyon appeals but the umpire feels it's bat first. The replays however shows the opposite. That was a close shout but Australia have no DRS left.
Tossed up ball on middle, helped off the pads to mid-wicket.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to long off for a run.
Lunges to defend but it spins away to beat his bat. Wade quickly takes the bails off, appeals but nothing from the square leg umpire.
Loopy full ball on off, Yadav defends it by getting forward.
Flatter and spinning into the batsman from outside off, Jadeja goes deep back in and punches it through cover-point. A single taken.
Flighted and outside off, Jadeja gets forward to defend but it whizzes past the outside edge.
Loopy full ball on off, Jadeja eases it down through mid off for one.
Tossed up ball on off, Yadav gets down to slog it over mid-wicket but it comes off the inside half. Hence there is not enough timing and the fielder in the deep stops the ball. A single taken.
Sharp spin down the leg side, Yadav gets across to hit it off his pads but misses. Good take by Wade.
Full floated ball outside off, Yadav is on the front foot in defense.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Jadeja leans forward to defend but it takes the inside half of the bat and runs through backward square leg for a single.
Flighted and full on off, from around the wicket, Jadeja gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Drinks break.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Skidding off the surface outside off, Jadeja pushes at it and misses.
Loopy and on leg, Yadav gets forward and plays it with an angled bat to covers for one.
Too full in length on off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Spinning back in sharply, Jadeja pushes at it but misses.
Flighted and landing outside off, Jadeja takes his front leg out and pads it away.
Jadeja has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, pushed to mid on for one.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Forces a full ball to mid on and scampers across to the other end.
Sliding down the leg side, Jadeja tries to flick but misses.
Angles across a length ball on middle, Jadeja opens the face of the bat and pushes it with gentle hands through point. Good running between the wickets to take two runs.
Floated and full outside off, Umesh draws forward and defends it to point.
Quicker and flatter on middle, defended solidly by Yadav.
Loopy and on off, Yadav defends it by getting forward. He is not try anything fancy and letting Jadeja do all the hitting. Seems that was the message from the dressing room.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Hurries down the track to a full ball and forces it to covers for a run.
Flatter and turning back into the batsman from outside off, Jadeja goes back in defense.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Umesh covers the line and shoulders arms. 200 overs are done and dust, India lead by 105 runs!
Short and on middle, Jadeja pulls it across the line and it goes in the air in front of square leg. Doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep and they run a single.
Fullish and on middle and off, another tight defensive shot by RJ.
Full and on middle, Jadeja gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played! Hazlewood angles across a shortish ball on off, Jadeja rocks back and plays a late cut down to third man for a boundary.
A touch short and going down the leg side, Jadeja tries to glance but misses.
Floated one on off, fuller in length, Umesh lunges and defends it off the inner half of the bat to backward square leg.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.

Gets forward and drives a full ball to extra cover.
Full floated ball on off, Yadav lunges in defense.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single. INDIA LEAD BY 100 RUNS!

Chance of a run out! Good length ball on leg, Jadeja keeps it out on the leg side and rushes for a risky run. Renshaw moves across to his right from mid-wicket, picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Direct hit and Jadeja would have been a goner.
Swing and a miss! Full and angling away from the southpaw, Jadeja clears his front leg as he aims to clear mid-wicket with his hoick but no connection is made.
Jadeja has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Dropped by Steve O'Keefe! Back of a length ball on off, Umesh tries pump it down the ground but it comes high on his bat and he ends up mistiming it in the air towards mid on. O'Keefe tries his best, sticks his left hand out but fails to grab the ball. A single taken.
Beaten! Full and outside off, a hint of inswing, Yadav gets forward, pushes inside the line and is beaten.
Shortish and around off, cut through point for one.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Plays it with soft hands to point and crosses for one.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Flighted ball on off, spinning in, Jadeja shimmies down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep but it goes wide of him to the boundary.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flatter, quicker and fuller on leg, defended by Yadav.
Floated ball on leg, Yadav tries flicking but gets a little leading edge on the off side.
Umesh Yadav walks in next.

OUT! Saha departs after playing a top knock. O'Keefe serves a flighted full ball around leg, Saha makes room, advances down the track and tries to go inside-out over covers. But he fails to middle it and ends up handing a straightforward catch to Maxwell at short cover. The Indian wicketkeeper walks back amidst a big cheer from the crowd. India lead by 90 runs!
Pushes it quicker and flatter on off, Ravindra goes back and blocks it safely.

FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished. Short and outside off, Jadeja gets back to cut, deals with the extra bounce well and slaps it square of the wicket. Hazlewood puts in a lazy dive, almost after the ball has passed. A boundary to Jadeja's name.
Tossed up ball on off, from around the wicket to the left-hander, Jadeja lunges in defense.
Flatter off spinner on off, Saha goes back and taps it down to point for a run.
Lets the ball to spin down the leg side and then nudges it off his pads to short fine leg. Ends up playing it straight to the fielder and hence no run taken.
Floated full ball on off, pushed back by Saha and Lyon moved across to his right to stop the ball with a dive.
Saha tucks this floated delivery through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Tosses this one outside off, Saha drives it to covers.
Fuller delivery, spins back in, Jadeja flicks it through mid-wicket for one run.
Shortish delivery, Jadeja punches it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter and around leg, Saha tucks it very fine. One run taken.
Tosses this one outside off, Jadeja knocks it through mid on for one run.
Shorter and outside off, tapped to point and takes a single.
Floated delivery, outside off, Saha goes back and places it perfectly through third man for three runs.
Jadeja opens the face of the bat and dabs it to point to get off the mark with a single.
Full and on the sticks, Jadeja bunts it back to the bowler.
Ravindra Jadeja arrives.

OUT! The marathon innings comes to an end and it was an uncharacteristic shot. He was playing to the situation and sacrificed his wicket. Lyon bowled a shortish delivery, Che goes to nudge it over mid-wicket but doesn't get the shot right. Maxwell cups it easily at that position. And Cheteshwar Pujara has to depart. He does and to a standing ovation. Good gesture from the Aussies as they shake his hands.
Pujara dances down the track to this tossed up delivery and mistimes his shot towards deep mid-wicket. However, the ball falls short of the deep fielder. Two runs taken.
Saha sweeps this negative line delivery to short fine leg.
FOUR! Right then, India is moving on. Steve floats this on off, Saha makes room and plays the inside out drive over covers for a boundary.
Bowls it slower through the air and keeps it on the stumps, blocked.
Bowls this down the leg side, Saha leaves it alone.
Saha comes down the track and pushes it towards mid off.
Mid-wicket drops back.

The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Saha flicks this towards mid-wicket for one run.
3rd Test double hundred for Cheteshwar Pujara, second against Australia!

A momentous occasion this for Cheteshwar Pujara. He has absolutely brought India in command with this stupendous knock. Even Steven Smith applauds his effort. Anil Kumble is ready to capture the moment with his camera. Simply brilliant. Coming to the ball, it was looped up around leg, he flicked it through mid-wicket for a single. Takes his helmet off and celebrates by raising his arms. Top stuff!
Floated delivery on middle, nudged towards FSL.
Tosses it outside off, defended towards point.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Saha skips down the track and defends this tossed up delivery.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
In the air....lands safe. Saha charges down the track and whacks it over mid off. Doesn't quite time it that well and Renshaw cuts it off. Three runs added to the total.
Pujara gets down the track and clips it through mid-wicket. Single taken.
Slower through the air and on leg, Saha works it through the leg side. One run added to the total.
Che flicks this tossed up delivery through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
Pujara tucks it past FSL for one run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Short and easy pickings, Pujara pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. It rolls away quite quickly.
Full and around middle, blocked towards covers.
Che dances down the track and clips this tossed up delivery to mid-wicket.
Che flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it on the sticks, Che blocks it on the back foot.
On the pads, defended well.
Shortish delivery, on middle and leg, put away to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
3rd Test hundred for Wriddhiman Saha!

Here it is! A brilliant ton from the Indian keeper. Maxwell starts the over with a shortish delivery around leg, Saha tucks it through square leg for a single and brings up the milestone. Kohli, Rahane, Nair all of them are cheering from the dressing room. The Indian captain is the happiest, not for the first time that he is delighted at a teammate's milestone.

The tired Australian players walk out for the final session of day 4. The Indian batsmen still look fresh, wonder how, and are strolling out too. The plan should be to score quick runs and the visitors will look to put brakes on those. Glenn Maxwell will start the proceedings for Australia.
...DAY 4, SESSION 3...

Yet another fantastic session for India! Cheteshwar Pujara and Wriddhiman Saha continued to frustrate the Australian bowlers. They had answers to all the questions asked by the visiting team and are nearing their individual milestones now. India are in the lead by 52 runs and would hope that the current pair keeps on rolling. Australia are looking completely out of sorts and are waiting for things to happen. Let's see how the last session goes.
CP looks to defend this but fails to put bat on ball. And that will be tea on day 4.
Bowls the same length, Che looks to tickle it away but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit his pads.
Shortish delivery, Che nudges it to the leg side.
Shorter and on the sticks, Saha camps back and tucks it through mid-wicket, where the fielder misfields. They run a single.
Fuller and on off, Saha defends.
Slides it down the leg side, Pujara tickles it to fine leg for a single. The crowd cheers because Saha is back on strike.
Shortish and outside off, Saha looks to cut but the ball bounces a bit more and turns too, beating the batsman in the process.
Shorter and around off, Saha knocks it back to the bowler.
Bowls this on the sticks, Saha dead-bats it.
Slides it around off, Saha offers a front foot defense.
Slower through the air and on off, Che softly plays it towards the off side. Single taken.
Tosses this one around leg, Saha nudges it through square leg. One run taken. 500-run mark comes up.

Lunges to a full ball and pushes it towards mid on.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Saha has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Fine shot! Saha uses his feet to run down to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Comes down the track and plays it past short mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Saha inside edges his attempted sweep shot to short fine leg.
Short and around off, Saha rocks back and punches it towards covers where Lyon misfields. They run two.
Saha bunts this towards the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Che nudges this delivery to short fine leg and runs one.
Gets ahead and blocks. Pujara has now faced the most number of balls by an Indian in an innings, beating his No 3 predecessor Rahul Dravid.
Saha flicks this shortish delivery to towards mid-wicket.
Saha pushes this tossed up delivery to the off side and runs one.
Drags his length back, Saha rocks back and nudges it to backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this on the leg, Saha sweeps it fine and runs two.
Short and outside off, Saha pats it to point.
Tosses this on leg, Saha knocks it back to the bowler. Lyon appeals, wonder why, as it went on the bounce to him.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Looped up delivery, fifth stump line, pushed to covers.
Pujara bunts this floated delivery back to the bowler.
Floats it around leg, Che defends it past the FSL.
Bowls it on the off stump, pushes it away.
Tosses this one on middle, Che pads it away.
Saha sweeps this negative line it to fine leg for a single.
Short of a length delivery, sixth stump line, Saha steers it down to third man. One run added to the total.
