Fuller delivery outside off, Saha looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat to the bowler.
Shortish delivery down the leg, Saha decides to let it through.
Back of a length delivery, which comes back in, WS ducks to leave it alone.
Bouncer, outside off, Saha allows Wade to gather it.
Pujara has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Saha eases this down to long off. One run taken.
Saha blocks this tossed up delivery off the front foot.

Floats this on leg, Saha paddle sweeps to fine leg. The fielder in the deep throws it to Wade, who tries to do a Dhoni by throwing it behind without seeing. But he misses the stumps and there was no one backing up which results in another run.
Tosses this one around leg, Saha skips down the track and drives to covers.
Full and on the sticks, Pujara nudges it to mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Ends the over with an inswinging full ball, it's driven to mid off.

NOT OUT! Steven Smith has taken a review out of desperation. Pat bowls a back of a length delivery, which nips back in. Think it was the off cutter. Saha looks to get out of its way and the ball hits something and lobs towards Smith at first slip, who dives ahead and grabs a good low catch. After a brief talk, the Australian skipper opts for DRS. Replays clearly show that it came off Saha's chest. The players resort back to their positions.
Appeal for a catch taken by Smith at first slip. He is not too sure but still goes for the DRS as the umpire shakes his head.
Short of a length delivery, Saha defends it off the back foot towards the FSL.
Cummins sticks to bowling another bouncer, down the leg side, Saha sways away.
Bumper around leg, Saha sits underneath it again.
Cummins runs in and delivers a bouncer, Saha ducks.
Once again the umpires are in conversation with the players regarding the fading light. They stay...
Bowls the same length, Saha nudges it to backward square leg. One run added to the total.
Short and on leg, Che tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it outside off, Che pushes it towards covers.
Tosses this on the leg, Che flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Action replay of the last ball.
Negative line, Pujara treats it just as it should be.
The umpires are keeping a closing eye on the fading light. They have a little chat with the players and are staying. Steve O'Keefe to continue.
Fuller delivery, extracts good bounce, Saha adjusts to it well and defends.
On a length, it nips back in, Pujara nudges it through square leg for a single. 150-run stand comes up.
It has turned quite dark out there.
Bowls a well-directed bouncer, Che gets out of its way.
Fullish delivery, Pujara offers a front foot defense.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Saha cuts it through point for a single.
Full and on middle, Saha flicks it uppishly past the mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Bowls the negative line, Pujara blocks it with his front pad.
Full and on the sticks, Che leans to bury it.
Same length, Che kicks it away.
Pujara flicks this ball which was again on the pads.
Sprays it outside leg, Pujara leaves it but watched it till the very end.
Bowls it outside leg, padded away.

Fuller length ball, Saha looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and hits the pads. The Australians went up but then realized that there was an inside edge. Replays however show that there wasn't and it would've missed the leg stump.
Shortish delivery, way outside off, Saha plays the ramp shot seeing there is no third man and runs two.
Fullish delivery, on the sticks, Saha clips it towards the leg side.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Saha rocks back to block.
Angles a full length ball, Saha flicks to mid-wicket.
Sprays it down the leg side, Pujara nudges it to deep square leg for a comfortable single. Pujara now holds the record for facing the most balls by an Indian batsman in Tests at home.
Short and on middle, Saha makes room and punches to covers.
Saha clears his front leg and knocks this tossed up delivery back to the bowler.
Same length, paddle sweeps it to Lyon at short fine leg.
Full and on the sticks, Saha dead-bats.
Sprays this outside leg, Saha lets his pad do the talking.
Tosses this one around leg, bunts towards mid on.
Drinks have been called.
Presents the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Shout for a catch! Back of a length ball around off, nipping back in to beat Pujara's defense. It goes behind where Wade dives to his left to collect the ball with one hand. They appeal as there was some noise but the umpire shows no interest. No DRS taken by Smith and the replays confirm that the noise was off the ball brushing the thigh pad.
Short ball outside off, Che sways away from the line.
Pujara has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! That's edgy and screams past the flying keeper. Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Pujara tries to glance but it takes the inner half of the bat and runs away to the fine leg fence. Hazlewood stands in the middle of the pitch looking frustrated. In fact, after watching the replays, it's tough to find the inside edge. Hmmm...
Stays back and punches it towards the bowler.
Tossed up and around leg, Saha lunges ahead and defends it solidly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes quicker and lands it full outside leg, Saha tries to play the paddle sweep but fails to middle it.
Floated ball on leg, Saha lunges and defends it to the off side.
Flatter and on the pads, helped to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and landing outside leg, Pujara allows it through.
Too full in length on off, Saha drives it to mid off. The fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end, it deflects, they think about a run but then decide against it.
Full and around off, Saha lunges and defends it to short cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Saha has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.

Ooohhh...this one stays very low. Hazlewood bowls it on a fuller length just around off, Saha tries defending but it goes below his bat to the keeper. Had that been in the line of the stumps, Saha would have been lbw.
Fires a full ball down the leg side, Pujara pads it away.

Mishit but safe! Flighted and around leg, spinning away a touch, Saha comes down the track for a big shot, fails to middle it but luckily it goes over mid off. Warner chases it and pulls it back just before the rope. Three runs added to the total.
Both the batsmen are closing in on their individual milestones, but the need of the hour now is to attack and India is exactly trying to do that.
Jumps out of the crease to a fuller length ball and chips it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Not quite from the middle of the bat.

Very full and on leg, Pujara gets back and helps it to mid-wicket for a run. A 69-year old record has been broken as this becomes the highest 7th wicket partnership against Australia for India in Tests.
Loopy and around leg, Che gets forward and defends it solidly.
Flighted and landing outside leg, from over the wicket, Pujara pads it away.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.

Shout for an lbw! A touch short in length on middle, angling down, Saha tries to flick but misses and it goes off his thigh pad to fine leg. They appeal and the batsmen cross a couple of times. The umpire waits for the Aussies to take the DRS and after sensing that they won't, he signals leg byes.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish and angling in, Saha gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler. Hazlewood collects the ball and has an immediate shy at the striker's end as Saha rushes back.
Sliding down the leg side, it's nicely flicked through square leg for a single.
Fuller and angling into the batsman, some extra bounce as Pujara gets forward and defends it with a loose bottom hand to the short mid-wicket region.
Change of ends for Josh Hazlewood.
Bowls it with a round-arm action and lands it around off, Saha gets back in defense.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Plays with soft hands and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Loopy and drifting in from around off, Pujara gets down the track and defends it to the leg side.
Flatter and full on off, driven through covers for a single.
Spears in a full ball on off, Cheteshwar gets forward and defends it back to the bowler. Top class concentration shown by Che, he has been batting in the middle for more than 9 hours now.
Speedy delivery, a touch short and drifting down the leg side, Pujara tries to glance it off his hips but misses.
Rising delivery on off, Pujara goes on his toes and taps it down to point.
Digs in a short ball just outside off, Pujara drops his wrists and sways away from the line.
Bowls from wide of the crease and angles in a length ball on off, Saha taps it down in the gap at cover-point and jogs across to the other end.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Pujara uses the pace and runs it down to third man for a run.
Quicker full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
A lovely looking drive off the front foot but it once again has gone straight to the fielder at covers.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it to extra cover.
Leans forward and pushes it with gentle hands to covers for one.
Appeal for an lbw, turned down. Tossed up ball outside off, Pujara tries to defend but misses. He is hit on the pads, Wade appeals but the impact was well outside off.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Che defends it off the inner half of the bat to short leg.
Steve O'Keefe comes back into the attack.
Angles in a full ball on off, Saha defends it off his front foot.
Vicious bouncer around leg, well-directed, Saha ducks at the last moment.
Full and on off, Saha decides to stay back and defend it towards the short cover fielder.
Wrong line, on a good length and sliding down the leg side, Pujara nudges it through backward square leg for a run. INDIA ARE IN THE LEAD!
Back of a length ball outside off, Saha pushes it from the back foot through cover-point for a run.
Dishes out a length ball on off, shaping in, Saha gets back to play through the line but it catches the inside edge and hits him on the thigh pad.
Pitches it up and just outside off, Pujara gets forward and defends it watchfully.
Bouncer down the leg side, Pujara ducks.
On a length and outside off, Saha stays back and steers it through backward point for a run. 450 up for India!
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Good length ball angling into the batsman with extra bounce, Pujara gets back on his toes to defend it back.
Bouncer, around middle, Cheteshwar ducks and Wade jumps to collect the ball over his head.
Another false shot. Cummins bowls it short and wide outside off, Saha flashes away from the body and misses.
Serves it full and around off, Saha stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to covers.
Peach of a delivery! Cummins steams in and hurls a back of a length ball just around off, some extra lift on this occasion, Saha is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
Sharp delivery, Cummins bangs in a short ball on off, Saha leans back and sways away from the line.
Good length ball on off, Saha goes back in defense.

FOUR! Wow, Saha is growing in confidence and is playing some extraordinary shots. An overpitched delivery off, Wriddhiman leans forward and caresses it through the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary. Runs are coming thick and fast against the third new ball.
Lands it fuller and outside off, Pujara drives it off his front foot to the cover fielder.
Length and on off, Pujara presents a straight face and defends it off his back foot.
Square leg drops back.
FOUR! The bowler gets greedy here. Tries to repeat the last delivery from the middle stump but this time Pujara covers the line and beautifully flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Full and outside off, an outswinger, Pujara pushes at it with unsure footwork and gets beaten.
Targets the middle stump with a fuller length ball, angling in, Pujara gets behind the line and defends it to mid on.
Pitches it full and outside off, going straight on, Pujara is content in leaving it.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Beaten all ends up! Terrific delivery, good pace. It lands on a length just outside off and skids through the surface, Saha has a tame push inside the line and misses.
A touch short and on off, Saha goes on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Angles it in around off, Saha offers a straight bat and defends it off his back foot.
Another swinging delivery, full and curling in around middle, Saha flicks across the line but finds short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Pristine timing! Full and swinging delivery, outside off, Saha reaches out for it away from his body and creams it through covers for a glorious boundary.
Starts with a length ball around off, Pujara gets forward and softly plays it wide of point for a run.

The Australian players are sauntering out in the middle. Some news for Indian fans, Virat Kohli was seen doing catching practice which indicates he might take field in the third innings. Cheteshwar Pujara and Wriddhiman Saha are out and will eye to up the ante. Pat Cummins will bowl the first over of the session. Australia have taken the third new ball.
...DAY 4, SESSION 2...

Marvelous session for India! The whole Indian team is out near the gallery of the dressing room to applaud Cheteshwar Pujara and Wriddhiman Saha. Shows how terrific they both were in the first session, truly phenomenal. They did what the hosts must have planned, bat the whole session without losing any wicket. The morale of Australia has understandably dropped and they desperately need some inspiration. The luck too was not with them as two chances that their bowlers created were overturned after the use of DRS. The home side's deficit is now only 16 and they should ideally wipe it out and look to accelerate from there. Join us in a bit for the second session to find out which way the game heads.
Faster and flatter, Saha goes on the back foot and blocks it with a straight face of the bat. Lunch on day 4!

NOT OUT! Australia weren't too confident for a caught behind but review it anyway. Lyon loops it outside off, Saha looks to sweep but misses and Wade catches it. The visitors think that Saha has nicked it and after a brief discussion Smith reviews it. Replays indicate that there was day light between bat and ball and the sound which came was of the bat hitting the turf.
Huge shout for a catch as Wade grabs the ball. The umpire remains still and Smith after chatting with his wicketkeeper takes the DRS.
Tossed up outside off, Saha defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Shortish and spins back in, Che tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and outside off, Pujara did what he does best.
Shorter and outside off, Saha goes on his back foot and cuts it through covers. The cover fielder gives it a chase to stop the ball. Three runs added to the total.
Third new ball is available.
Loops this one outside off, Saha drills it through covers. Single taken.
Short and it keeps low, WS adjusts to it well and jams it towards the leg side.
Tosses this one outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Bowls it slower through the air, Che knocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Pujara defends it off the front foot.
Slides it down the leg side, Saha tucks it through square leg. One run added to the total.
Shorter delivery which comes back in, Pujara goes on his back foot and punches it to the cover region.
Fullish and on the sticks, Che bunts it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Che dead-bats it.
100-run stand between Pujara and Saha!
Shortish again, this time it bounces a bit more, Saha blocks it with soft hands past FSL for a single. An outstanding partnership this. They have batted with total authority.
Short and on leg, Che goes back and works it through fine leg for a single.
Full and on leg, Che has blocked it on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loops this one outside off, Saha pushes it to covers.
Floats this on off, Saha goes on the front foot to defend.
Saha blocks this tossed up delivery with a straight face of the bat.
Bowls it slower through the air and around middle, Saha buries it.
Fuller and around leg, Saha looks to paddle but it goes off his right arm wide of the first slip fielder.
Tosses this one on the sticks, Pujara's defense goes on to hit the pads.
Che dances down the track and clips this looped up delivery to the leg side.
Floats this on middle, Che camps back and blocks it with a straight face of the bat.
Fuller and on the sticks, Che has blocked.
Tossed up around leg, Saha uses his feet and flicks it uppishly through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Shorter and outside off, goes back and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Tosses this one around leg, Che flicks it towards the leg side. One run added to the total.
Saha knocks this tossed up delivery through mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

DROPPED! Shortish delivery on off, Saha camps back for a cut but only manages a faint edge and Wade fails to catch it! It was a very difficult chance to be honest. The shoulders are dropping in the field and the Aussies are looking disheartened.
Fuller and on off, Saha prods forward in defense.
Floats this one on leg, Pujara flicks it through square leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Che flicks this shortish delivery through square leg for a single. 1000 Test runs for Pujara against Australia!

NOT OUT! India's reviews have been spot on in Ranchi. Another successful one. Lyon floats this one around middle, Pujara goes forward to block but misses and gets pinged on the front pad. Che reviews it straightaway after the umpire obliges to Lyon's appeal. Hawk Eye shows that it would've missed the leg stump, in fact it was going too far away.
Huge shout for an lbw and umpire Ian Gould raises his finger. Cheteshwar Pujara takes the DRS.
Drags his length back, Pujara whips it straight to forward short leg.
Tosses this one around middle, Saha paddle sweeps it through fine leg for a single.
Bowls it slower through the air and keeps it on middle, Saha opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards the off side.
Fuller and on middle, Pujara stone-walls it.
Tosses this one around leg, Che tucks it to backward square leg.
Bowls it full, Pujara dead-bats it.
5th Test fifty for Wriddhiman Saha!

Fifty for the Indian wicketkeeper batsman. Saha eases this floated delivery through mid off for a single. A very crucial knock from Saha and skipper Kohli has certainly loved it. He applauds it from the dressing room.
Quicker delivery outside off, Saha offers a front foot defense.
Sprays it on the pads, Che tucks it through fine leg. One run taken.
Short and on middle, Che rocks back and punches it towards covers. Single taken.
Loops this one around pads, flicked away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on leg, Pujara looks to tickle but misses. The ball raps his pads. Lyon appeals but the umpire is not interested as it was going down the leg side.
Floats this one around leg, Pujara buries it.
Bowls it around leg, Saha paddle sweeps it to fine leg for one run.
SIX! Saha gets into the action. Lyon tosses it up around leg, Saha skips down the track and whacks it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Spin! Pitches this on off, Che looks to block but it spins past the outside edge.
Short and Pujara pulls it away through square leg for a brace.
Floats this one outside off, Pujara lets Wade do his job.
Tosses this one around off, Che is rock solid in defense.
Fuller delivery around off, Pujara stonewalls it.
Saha has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Saha has offered a front foot defense.
Che comes down the track and clips this floated delivery through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around middle, Pujara uses his feet and flicks to mid-wicket.
Saha too dances down the ground and drives this floated delivery through covers for a single.
Pujara gets to the pitch of this tossed up delivery and knocks it towards extra cover for a single.
Half chance! Pujara looks to defend this looped up delivery but it takes the outside edge and goes back. It hits Wade's pads before he can react and rolls past Smith at first slip. A run taken.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara kicks it away.
Floats this one outside off, Che buries it.
Pujara knocks this tossed up delivery to mid on.
Strays on the leg side, Che defends it.
Bowls it outside off, Pujara offers a front foot defense.
Spin from both ends. Steve O'Keefe is back on.

Pujara's love for daddy hundreds continues! Lyon loops this one outside off, Che pats it past backward point off the outside half of the bat and steals a quick single. What a brilliant knock this from India's No 3. This is his longest innings in terms of ball faced. Herculean effort!
Drags his length back a bit, and keeps it on leg, Pujara tucks it towards the leg side.
Fuller delivery, 96 kph, Pujara dead-bats it.
Fuller and on the pads, Pujara nudges it towards square leg.
Quicker delivery, outside off, Saha defends it towards mid off and runs one.
Floats this one outside off, taps it to point.
On a length outside off, Saha looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes towards third man. Single taken.
Bangs this short and manages to extract extra bounce, Saha gets over the ball, removes the bottom hand from the handle and blocks it.
Off cutter and back of a length, Pujara gets on his toes and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. 400-run mark comes up for India, they trail by 51 runs.
Bouncer again, Pujara ducks to leave it alone.
Back of a length delivery, around leg, Pujara hops and manoeuvres it towards the on side.
Shorter delivery, way over Pujara's head. Wade collects it.
Short and on the sticks, goes on his back foot to block.
Huge appeal for LBW! Turned down. Floats this around leg, Saha prods forward to block but it hits his pad. Lyon goes up but Ian Gould is unmoved. Maybe it was going away from the leg side.
Drags his length back, Pujara tucks it through square leg. One run added to the total.
Sprays it around leg, Saha tickles it fine on the leg side and runs one. It was Pujara who made the call and his partner responded.
Full and on the sticks, Saha leans forward in defense.
Tosses this one on middle, Saha goes back and pats it towards point.
Back of a length ball on middle, Pujara defends it from the back foot.

Cummins is getting predicable with his line and length. Goes short again and down the leg side, Pujara leaves. The bowler needs to be careful here as this around the wicket angle will create a lot of rough for Ravichandran Ashwin.
Digs in another short ball around leg, Che ducks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another bouncer, Pujara is at ease as he lets it go over his head after crouching.
Bouncer first up, as expected, from around the wicket, Pujara ducks underneath it.

Pat Cummins is back for another burst. Interesting field set up. There is a short leg and short backward square leg in place along with a fielder in the deep on the leg side. It seems plenty of short pitch bowling is coming up.
Drinks break.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Probably a slider, a touch short on middle, skidding away, Pujara punches it across the line but straight to short mid-wicket where Maxwell misfields a bit. No run taken.
Lyon cuts down his length and bowls it around leg, Saha goes back and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Full floated ball on middle, Saha gets forward and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Flatter this time, on middle, Saha goes back and defends it to the leg side.
Comes from around the wicket and serves a shortish off spinner on off, turning back in sharply, Saha gets back immediately and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Nathan Lyon replaces O'Keefe in the attack.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it. Once again some words hurled by Hazlewood but Pujara is not the kind of the batsman to retaliate. He will let his bat and patience do all the talking.
Hazlewood runs in from around the wicket and angles across a back of a length ball on middle and off, Pujara plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Bumper on off, Che sits underneath it with ease.
Good length delivery outside off, Pujara nicely eases it through the gap at covers for a couple of runs.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles in a length ball on off, Pujara gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flatter and fuller on middle, 83 kph, Pujara lunges and brings his bat ahead of his front pad in defense.
Flighted and outside off, Pujara leaves it alone.
Gets forward to a full ball on off and defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy on off, blocked.
Full floated ball on off, Pujara draws forward and pushes it to the off side.

Hazlewood bends his back and goes short on off, Saha keeps it out awkwardly to the off side. Some words exchanged between the bowler and the batsman. The umpires quickly get into the act and calm things down.

Well the replays are being shown of the ball number 139.4. It seems like that Pujara nicked it. Interestingly umpire Chris Gaffaney was about to raise his dreaded finger. But after seeing that the Australians didn't appeal, he stopped from doing so and acted to adjust his hat. Funny!
In the zone outside off, holding its line, Saha lets it through to the keeper.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes very full and around off, Saha tries flicking through mid-wicket but his bottom hand comes off the handle and it squirts through square leg for a couple of runs.
Back of a length ball on off, it's punched off the back foot to covers where Handscomb makes a tumbling stop. Cannot prevent the single.
Bouncer around off, Pujara ducks underneath it.
EDGED BUT SAFE! SOK slows this up in the air and lands it around off, extra bit of zip and bite this time, Saha lunges to defend but it takes the outside edge and rolls safely towards point.
Lands it a touch shorter around the rough area, Pujara gets back inside the crease and nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Goes from over the wicket and targets the rough outside leg, Pujara pads it away.
Loopy and landing on middle, Saha drives it straight and sends it down to deepish mid off for a run.
Full flighted ball on off, pushed off the front foot to short cover.
Fires in a flatter full ball on leg, Saha makes space and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Fullish and angling in on off, Che gets forward and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Floodlights have been switched on.
On a length and outside off, Pujara cuts it square of the wicket on the off side but straight to Maxwell at point.
False shot. Hazlewood cuts down his length and bangs it in short, Pujara takes the challenge to pull it but fails to connect. That was not very far from his gloves.
Serves it very full and around off, Che drives it square of the wicket but straight to the point fielder.
Some rain drops in the air.
Full and angling in on middle, Pujara plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Short in length and outside off, Pujara throws his bat at it and chops it down to third man for a couple.
Sends it flat and short on middle, skidding in, Saha gets back and eases it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The deficit is now 68 runs.
Floated ball on off, Saha gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Flatter arm ball on off, Saha gets forward to defend but it takes a big inside edge and hits him on the pads.
Gets back to a shortish ball and helps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and down the leg side, Che pads it away.
Fires a full ball on off, Pujara defends it back.
Bowls it short and wide outside off, Che reaches out for it and runs it down to third man for a run.
Fuller and outside off, driven off the outside half of the bat through backward point for a run.
On a length and around off, Saha remains back and taps it down towards point.
Lands it fuller and around off, Saha plays it with soft hands and pushes it to covers.
Angles in a full ball on off, Saha draws forward and defends it solidly to the off side.
Nearly chops it back on! Hazlewood hurls in a length ball just outside off, Saha tries to play a late dab down to third man but gets a bottom edge. It falls very closely towards the stumps.
Josh Hazlewood is back on. A slip is in place.
Quicker one, fires it down the leg side, Pujara offers no shot. A bit of a negative line this.
Lands it outside leg, spinning away towards off, Pujara pads it away.
Floated ball on middle, defended back.
SOK returns to over the wicket and fires one down the leg side, Pujara allows it through.
50-run stand comes up between Cheteshwar Pujara and Wriddhiman Saha.
Flatter and a shade quicker on middle, 86 kph, Saha goes back and turns it to backward square leg for a run. A very vital partnership this for India as it continues to prosper.
Flighted ball on middle, 83 kph, Saha defends it to the off side.
Once again there seems to be some issue with the seam of the ball. The umpires this time are getting it changed.
A touch short and angling into the batsman, Pujara keeps it out from the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Saha stays back and steers it down to third man for a run.
Full and angling in around off, Saha sticks back and pushes it to extra cover.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it short and around off, Pujara rocks back and cuts it to third man for a run.
Wayward delivery, short and going down the leg side, Pujara has an easy leave. A good take by Wade behind the stumps.
Too full and on middle, Saha walks forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
A little short and outside off, spinning away, Saha plays away from the body and taps it down to point.
Drags his length short again, around off, Che gets deep inside the crease and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Nice shot. The key was that he picked the length early. SOK slows it up in the air and lands it a shade short around off, Pujara immediately goes on the back foot and pulls it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted full ball on off, Pujara gets forward and defends it back.
Width on offer outside off, Che runs it down to third man for a single.
A touch too straight this time, Saha closes the face of the bat and nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, straightening a touch, Saha pushes at it with an angled bat to backward point. Lyon quickly moves across to his left and dives to stop the ball.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.

Excellent delivery! It lands on a shortish length around off and shapes back in a shade. Saha goes back to push at it but the ball stays low and sneaks past the inside edge. Wade gets down to his left to collect the ball but fumbles a bit. Immediately recovers though and has a shy at the striker's end as Saha was looking for a run. Fails to find the stumps and anyway WS was safely in by then.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
SOK sticks to a fuller length ball on middle, Pujara is once again solid in his front foot defense.
A little shimmy down the pitch from Che as he defends a full ball calmly back to the bowler.
Pujara has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on middle, Pujara gets on the front foot to short leg.
Arm ball on middle, pushed through quicker, Pujara lunges to defend and keeps it out off the inner half of the bat.
Good delivery, flighted and landing on leg, Che tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It comes off the leading edge and rolls safely to covers.
Umpire Ian Gould is using a scissor to cut down the seam of the ball which has come out.

On a good length and outside off, Saha reaches out for it and pushes it through the gap at cover-point. By the time the third man fielder runs across to stop the ball, they take a couple of runs. Eventful first over by Cummins!
Bouncer this time to push the batsman inside the crease. Saha stays back and ducks.
Fullish and on off, Saha draws a bit forward and works it closely from his front pad. Finds short mid-wicket.
Cummins keeps his length full and drops it just around off, Saha is on the front foot confidently as he drives it straight to mid off.
FOUR! Take that for a reply. Cummins overpitches it a shade, outside off, Saha leans into the drive and thumps it through covers for a boundary.

NOT OUT! It's missing leg. Good use of the review by India. Cummins hurls in a length ball around off and gets it to tail back into the batsman. Saha with limited footwork tries playing across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Saha walks up to his partner and after a little conversation, he opts for the DRS. The replays show that it's going down and Saha can continue to bat.
Huge shout for an lbw. The finger goes up and Pat Cummins is pumped up. Saha with a quizzical look on his face walks up to his partner and then opts for the review.
Pat Cummins will bowl from the other end.
Flatter ball on off, Pujara gets forward and pushes it towards covers. Looks for a run but is sent back as Maxwell pounces onto the ball.
Loopy and on off, Pujara is early into the shot and plays it a shade uppishly towards the cover fielder.
Quicker full ball on off, Saha goes hard at it and gets it away off the outer half of the bat. It rolls wide of backward point and they take a single.
Full floated ball on off, Saha defends it by getting on the front foot.
Arm ball this time, full and on middle, Saha lunges to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Starts from around the wicket and lands a full ball outside off, Pujara gets down the track and pushes it to mid off for a run. Warner misses his shy at the bowler's end. Good intent first up by Che.
The Australian players are walking out. Cheteshwar Pujara and Wriddhiman Saha are at the centre. Time for the start of day 4. Steven Smith tosses the ball to Steve O'Keefe. Here we go...

Pitch report - The wicket hasn't really changed much, the cracks haven't widen. The deck has kept itself very well for the last three days. There is an opening up outside the off stump from one end. Spin will come into play very soon. The pitch hasn't kept as bad as predictions, yes the odd ball has kept low but otherwise it has been fine.

It is crucial for the hosts to cancel out the deficit as soon as possible. The weather is overcast, but it remains to be seen whether that impacts any passage of the game. Either sides would hope that it doesn't as they would be raring to take field. Another exciting day of cricket awaits us in this series. Stay with us to see what unfolds....

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the fourth day of the third Test between India and Australia. Cheteshwar Pujara stood in Australia's way, worked hard for a century and still is at the crease. On the other side, Pat Cummins ensured, on a pitch that hasn't assisted the bowlers, that Aussies still have a chance in this match. A lot at stake on day 4 as the pacers have started reversing more and it might assist the spinners soon.
...DAY 4, SESSION 1...

Pat Cummins once again was the standout bowler for Australia. He bowled with a lot of fire and bagged the prized scalps of Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane. The other Aussie bowlers fared decently but were not threatening. Their spinners were disappointing as they failed to get much purchase from the track. The morning session tomorrow will be crucial for both teams and it will decide which way this Test match will head. Do join us at 0930 local (0400 GMT) to catch all the action. Cheers!

At the end of the third day of this Test match, Australia find themselves ahead of India by 91 runs. We witnessed a cracking day of Test cricket. The hosts batted superbly in the first session but a brainfade from Murali Vijay right at the stroke of lunch saw him getting stumped. The middle order comprised of Virat Kohli, Ajinkya Rahane and Karun Nair failed to deliver and India were in a spot of bother. However, Cheteshwar Pujara and Wriddhiman Saha steadied the ship a bit towards the end to keep the game in balance.

Cheteshwar Pujara hugs his partner as he starts to walk to the pavilion. Good gesture shown by the Australian players as they go up to congratulate Pujara. It's been a monumental knock from India's number 3 as he held one end tightly whole day.
Angles in a full ball on off, Saha defends it safely and that will be stumps on day 3!
Once again Hazlewood keeps his length full and lands it around middle and off, Saha defends it from the back foot.
Too full and around off, Saha gets forward and pushes it off the inner half of the bat to short mid-wicket.
Bouncer around middle and leg, Saha ducks underneath it.
An overpitched ball on off, Saha gets on the front foot and pushes it straight to mid off.
Fullish and around off, Saha lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
Last over of the day coming up...
Flighted and outside off, turning away a bit, Pujara pads it away towards first slip.
Slows it in the air and serves a full flighted ball on off, 76 kph, Pujara gets forward in defense.
Flatter full ball on off, pushed in the gap at covers for a quick single.
Loopy and around off, Saha watches the line closely and lets it through to the keeper.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! SOK fires a full ball down the leg side, Saha kneels and nails his paddle sweep fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Saha has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Sliding down the leg side, it's nudged through backward square leg for a single.
Goes full again, around off, Pujara gets behind the line with a vertical bat and defends it back.
Bouncer around off, Pujara ducks underneath it.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and darts in a full ball on middle, Pujara gets behind the line and pushes it towards mid on.
Angles in a full ball on off, Pujara draws forward, gets behind the line and defends it back.
Returns to over the wicket and serves a flighted ball outside leg, Saha offers no shot and pads it away.
Slow loopy ball on middle, fuller in length, Saha is forward in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker full ball on off, 91 kph, Saha defends it off his front foot to the off side.
A little short and around off, Che gets back and turns it behind square leg for one.
Arm ball landing around off, Saha gets back and punches it down to long off for a run. Deficit for India is under 100 now.
Fullish and just around off, Saha opens the face of the bat and pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Fuller and on off, angling in, Wriddhiman drives it with good timing to mid off.
Short of a length ball on off, angling in, Pujara pulls it through square leg and takes a run.
Fine shot! Full and tailing back into the batsman from around off, Pujara quietly flicks it through the gap between two mid-wicket fielders for a couple of runs.
Bowls it fuller and on off, Pujara drives off his front foot to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Saha runs it down to third man for a run.
Fires in a quicker one on middle and leg, Pujara tries to work on the leg side but misses.
Too full in length on off, Pujara sticks back and pushes it to mid off.
Arm ball around off, fuller in length, pushed to covers.
Floated ball on off, Che gets forward in defense.
Play and a miss! Flatter and a touch shorter on off, straightening a touch, Pujara tries to cut but misses.
Too full in length on middle, pushed down to mid on.
Bouncer around off, Saha drops his wrists and ducks underneath it immediately.
Fullish and outside off, Saha pushes it off his front foot to short cover.
Big movement back into the batsman from a length outside off, Saha is hurried up, tries to keep it out but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Lands it very full and outside off, Pujara drives it easily through covers for a run.
Bowls it way wide outside off, an easy leave for Pujara.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fires in a quicker one on middle, it's helped to mid-wicket for one.
Turning away from the batsman outside off, Pujara has nothing to do with it.
Flatter and on off, defended from the back foot.
Flighted and outside off, left alone.
Gets forward and drives it through mid off for a run.
Floated full ball on off, defended back.
Good length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks firmly towards mid off.
Fuller ball outside off, Pujara lets it pass to the keeper.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Another length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Josh Hazlewood is back.
Flatter outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller ball outside off, presses forward and blocks it out to cover.
Full and outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Quicker ball outside off, a bit of turn and bounce as Saha lets it pass.
Fuller around off, leans into it and blocks it down the track.

FOUR! LOFTED! Saha decides to unsettle the spinner. Floated around middle, he steps out to that one and lofts it well over mid on. The bat face did turn a bit in his hand but cleared the fielder comfortably to get a boundary.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Pujara sits back and punches it through point for a brace.
FOUR! FAB SHOT! Shortish outside off, Pujara rises on his toes and cuts it superbly through the covers. Terrific shot and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller on middle, goes across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and blocks it solidly.
Back of a length outside off, Pujara looks to punch off the back foot but gets a bottom edge on it.
Drifting in around middle, solid forward press by Saha.
Flighted on leg stump, smothers it to the ground solidly.
Full and outside off, reaches out and drives it towards cover.
Slightly short outside off, turning away sharply, Saha nudges it with the spin to point.
FOUR! Drifting in around middle, Saha gets across and nails the sweep through square leg. Strikes it cleanly and finds the fence. Much needed one for India as runs have come at a premium.
Floated on off, leans into it and blocks solidly on to the track.
Full and outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Dug in short on middle, Pujara ducks under the bouncer.
Shortish around leg stump, Saha evades it and the ball swerves away beating Wade's stretch as the batsmen take a bye.
Keeps it fuller outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length on off, angling in, raps Saha on the thigh pad.
Length ball on fourth stump, tailing in, pushed gently towards cover.
Flatter around off, stays back and blocks it to cover.
Full and outside off, reaches out and defends it well.
Fuller on middle and leg, Pujara reaches out to that one and blocks.
Loopy around leg stump, Pujara again uses his pads and this time there is a stifled lbw appeal. Pitching outside leg.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Pujara again offers his pads to it.
Floated around leg stump, Pujara pads it away.
Pitched up outside off, Saha bunts it towards cover.
Fuller ball outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Wriddhiman Saha walks out to bat.

OUT! ANOTHER CUMMINS SPECIAL! His extra pace is making the difference for Australia on this unresponsive surface. Digs in a bumper from around off, Ashwin tries to get out of the way as the ball flies through to Wade who takes it easily. The appeal for a catch is instantaneous from the Aussies but turned down. Smith opts for the review straightaway. Legal ball and replays indicate a bit of glove. Snickometer confirms it as well and Ashwin has to go. He isn't happy for some reason. Fourth wicket for Cummins - what a return to Test cricket!
Australia have reviewed a caught behind appeal against Ashwin. They seem extremely confident.
Full ball outside off, pushed through cover for a brace. Good stop by Maxwell at cover.
Another full ball outside off, tailing in, Ashwin mistimes the drive towards cover.
Low full toss on middle, Ashwin works the inswinger towards mid on. Cummins was looking for the inswinging yorker.
Fuller ball outside off, defends it well off the front foot.
Loopy and around leg stump, Pujara doesn't offer a stroke yet again and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Fullish on middle and leg, defends it well towards short leg.
Flighted outside leg, Pujara offers his pads to that one.
Finally O'Keefe gets one to turn from this angle. Loopy and outside leg, turns square to beat the outside edge as Pujara is totally beaten.
Huge shout but missing the sticks! Another sharp inswinger that raps Ashwin on the pads. Loud appeal but clearly missing leg stump.

DROPPED! Cummins made a hash of what was actually a simple chance. Full inswinger around middle, Ashwin gets an inside edge on to the pad and it bobbles up towards Cummins who times the leap wrong. He probably expected it to come quicker and hence ended up fluffing the catch in his followthrough before falling on the pitch.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends well.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pats it to cover.
Back of a length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Fuller ball outside off, Ashwin drives it sweetly towards cover.
Drinks break....

Flatter around leg stump, Pujara goes back to flick but is hit on the pads. Needless appeal for lbw, pitching outside leg. The line itself is that and O'Keefe should be knowing it more than anyone else.
Fuller on leg stump, leans into it and defends well.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Pujara gave me something different to write. It seemed like another floated ball heading for the mark outside leg stump. Pujara reaches out and takes it on the full to smack it away towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy outside leg, there it is again folks, padded away.
Loopy and outside leg, Pujara isn't going to mind this one bit as this line means that the only person that can get him out is he himself.
Flighted outside leg, Pujara thrusts his pads at it.
Length ball outside off, stays back and defends firmly towards cover.
Good length angled in from outside off, blocked from the crease towards point.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends it solidly.
Good length on off, Ashwin blocks with a closed bat face towards short mid-wicket.
Good length around off, stays back to punch it through cover but gets it off the inside half towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller ball outside off, Ashwin plays a flowing drive towards mid off.
The padding session continues as Pujara offers his pads once again to a harmless ball pitched outside leg stump.
Fullish on leg stump, wristed away towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in around leg stump, Pujara gets well forward and pads it away.
Flatter and down the leg side, left alone to the keeper.
Loopy and outside leg, Pujara pads it away to the leg side.
Tossed up outside leg stump, harmless and Pujara kicks it away.
Keeps it full and attacks the sticks, Ashwin defends it from the crease with a straight bat.
Fuller on middle, worked gently towards mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Ashwin blocks it solidly from the crease.
Another full ball outside off, Pujara times the drive well again to mid off. This time the ball is to the left of the fielder and that allows the single.
Fuller ball outside off, Pujara drives it firmly towards mid off.
Good length outside off, Ashwin steers it to third man for a single.
Pat Cummins is back.
Floated around leg stump, Pujara pads it away to the leg side.
Drifting in around leg stump, Pujara pads it away and gets into a slight tangle there. No harm though as O'Keefe cannot get an lbw decision from this angle.
Floated on middle, reaches out and defends well.
Drifting in on leg stump, blocked solidly off the front foot on to the pitch.
Loopy around leg, once again Pujara offers his pads.
Floated around leg stump, Pujara pads it away.
Steve O'Keefe is back on.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed gently back to the bowler. Wicket maiden from Hazlewood.
Slips one down the leg side, Ashwin tries to flick but misses it.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the new man in.

OUT! ABSOLUTE RIPPER! Hazlewood comes wide of the crease and angles in a full ball outside off, tails in sharply to sneak between bat and pad to make a mess of the furniture behind him after brushing the back thigh. Hazlewood is pumped up and why not! The short ball off the previous delivery had probably kept Karun back in the crease. Beautifully set up.
Hazlewood tries the bouncer but Karun evades it in time.
Nair has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Josh Hazlewood runs in but Karun Nair pulls out at the last moment. Reason - The cloth piece hiding the advertisement boards has come off.
Pitches it full and outside off, straightening a touch, Nair allows it through to the keeper.
Tossed up ball outside off, Pujara mishits his drive to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A touch short and spinning back in, Pujara gets well forward and pads it away.
Flighted on off, turned to mid-wicket and they crossed for a brisk run. The fielder missed his shy at the non-striker's end otherwise it would have been close.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it in front of square leg. The fielder in the deep moves across to his left to stop the ball and they take a couple of runs.
Loopy full ball on off, Nair gets forward and flicks it with the turn to short mid-wicket. The fielder scored a direct hit at the bowler's end but Pujara was safely in.
Full and angling in around off, Che defends it by getting forward.
Shortish and outside off, Pujara cuts it from the crease but straight to point.
A slip comes into place. There is a short extra cover as well. It's a predominantly off side field.
Length delivery on off, Pujara plays a punchy drive by getting forward but fails to beat the cover-point fielder.
Back of a length ball around off, going straight on, Pujara leans back and sways away from the line.
Full and swinging in from around off, Pujara gets forward and presents a straight bat in defense.
Lands it on a length outside off, Nair stays back and dabs it through backward point for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Tossed up ball on middle, Karun defends it with the spin to the leg side.
Big spin back into the batsman from around off, extra bounce, Nair fails to defend and gets hit high on the pads.
Full floated ball on off, turning in, another back foot defense by Nair.
Allows the ball to spin back in from outside off, Nair defends it off his back foot to covers.
Flighted off spinner landing outside off, Karun goes back and defends it towards point.

Good length ball outside off, shaping back in, Nair stays back and opens the face of the bat to push it towards gully. Smith moves across swiftly to his right from second slip, dives but fails to make a clean stop. A single taken.
Gentle full delivery in the channel outside off, going straight on, Karun covers the line and shoulders arms.
Angles in a full ball on off, straightening a touch, Nair brings down a straight bat in defense.
Fullish on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Lands it full and outside off, Pujara makes an easy leave.
Full and around off, it's defended off the front foot by Nair.
Walks down to the pitch of the ball and forces it down to mid on for a single. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end and they take another run as Wade failed to collect it cleanly.
Spin and bounce back into the batsman from outside off, Pujara gets forward with his bat hiding behind the front pad. Gets rapped on the pads, they appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Once again goes hard at a full ball on off but flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Extra flight this time, full and outside off, Pujara comes down the track but hits it straight to mid on.
Floated full ball on off, Pujara decides to push it back off his back foot.
Flatter and a touch shorter around off, spinning back in, Nair goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller in length and on off, angling in with extra bounce, Pujara stays back and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Pujara punches it off his back foot to the bowler. Hazlewood collects it in his followthrough.
Serves it full and wide outside off, inviting the batsman to go for a drive but Pujara is in no mood to chase it.
Hazlewood persisting with a full length ball on off, angling in, Pujara is rock solid in defense.
Bowls it full again, just outside off, Che leans forward and defends it watchfully to short cover.
Lands it on a full length just outside off, some extra bounce, Pujara drives it on the up, controls his shot well and helps it towards covers.
Charges down the track and helps it to mid-wicket for a run.
Spinning in from around middle, Nair eases it down to deep backward square leg for one.
Flatter one, around off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on off, Nair pulls out a reverse sweep from his repertoire and places it through backward point for a couple of runs.

Four byes! Wow, excellent delivery, landing full just outside off and spinning back in with extra bounce. Nair leans forward to defend but misses and Wade fails to collect it. A boundary behind the wickets.
Loopy full ball landing outside off, Nair lunges and defends it back.
Nathan Lyon to continue from the other end.

Stifled appeal for a catch! Length ball angling down the leg side, Pujara tries to flick but fails to get the desired connection. There is some noise as it goes behind to the keeper. Wade catches it, they all appeal but nothing from the umpire. That sounded woody but no DRS taken by Australia. Hmm... Okay, the replays show that there was no bat involved. Fair call, then.
In the zone outside off, holding its line, Che covers the line and allows it through to Wade.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it square of the wicket on the off side, finds cover-point.
Bowls it full and around off, Pujara gets forward in defense to the off side.
Pujara has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Starts with a full length ball on off, Che gets forward and defends it to the off side.
31 overs left in the day's play. It's going to be Josh Hazlewood to begin proceedings. Pujara on strike...
The tourists have disbursed to take their positions in the field. Cheteshwar Pujara and Karun Nair are too walking out in the middle.
...DAY 3, SESSION 3...

It was Cheteshwar Pujara who stood his ground and upped the ante with his aggressive stroke making. He was a touch slow earlier but looked in fabulous nick since lunch. The pick of the Australian bowlers, again, was Pat Cummins who snared both the Indian wickets. The match could still go either way and a crucial last session awaits us. Join us in a bit for the third session.

It is said that the team that is more patient prevails in Test cricket and while India have still managed to score 110 runs, they will be disappointed at the shots, their captain and vice-captain played to get out. Two strokes that could've been avoided, two strokes that might hold too much importance if the visitors make a daunting comeback in the last session. The home side still trail by 148 runs and there is a lot of work left.
Once again straighter in line and on the shorter side, Pujara eases it through mid-wicket for a single. Tea on day 3!
Drops it short on middle, Karun goes back and punches it to covers for a run.
A touch flatter and shorter on middle, Pujara gets back and hits it through mid-wicket for one.
Jumps out of the crease and works a full ball with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Fullish and on off, pushed with an open face to covers for one. 300 up for India!
Flighted ball on middle, played with the spin to square leg.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Flighted and again outside leg, Che uses his pads to keep it out.
Loopy and landing outside leg, Pujara pads it away.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.
Bowls it flat and outside leg, staying low, Pujara keeps it out towards square leg.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, nudged through square leg for one.
Shortish and on middle, Pujara gets back and whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Nair has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy around off, Nair lunges in defense.
Too full in length on off, pushed with an angled bat to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Poor delivery by SOK, delivers it short and outside off, Nair camps back and cracks it through cover-point for a boundary.
Floated ball drifting in around leg, Nair tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It takes a soft leading edge and rolls back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery on off, skidding away, Nair goes back and punches it towards cover-point for a run. Maxwell stares at his landing area after delivering the ball.
Tossed up ball around leg, Nair goes back and defends it to the leg side.
A touch short and around middle and leg, Pujara turns it in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Flighted on off, Che draws forward and defends it watchfully.
Bowls it quicker and flatter on middle and off, staying low, Pujara does well to keep it out on the leg side.
Full floated ball on middle, from around the wicket, Pujara leans forward and defends it back.
Interesting move by Steven Smith. He brings Glenn Maxwell into the attack. He is a handy off spinner.
Floated full ball on off, Pujara is on the front foot in defense.
Straightaway SOK goes on the negative line and bowls it around the pads, Che turns it wide of short fine leg and takes a run.
FOUR! Comes from over the wicket and bowls it very full on middle, Pujara attacks it with all his power and forces it down the ground for a boundary at long off.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flighted and outside off, Nair allowed it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Fine shot! SOK serves it full and around off, Nair walks forward, makes some room and drives it uppishly through the line. It goes wide of the short cover fielder and races away to the fence.
Bouncer, nicely directed at the batsman, Pujara ducks.
Goes fuller around off and gets it to swing back in, Pujara presses forward and defends it off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Another back foot defense by Pujara.
On a length and around off, Pujara defends it from the crease.
Cheteshwar Pujara slams his 11th Test century.

FOUR! Hundred for Pujara and he gets there with a sublime cover drive. A fuller length ball outside off, Che strides forward and caresses it through the gap on the off side for a boundary. The Ranchi crowd gets the chance to make some noise and Pujara raises his bat in celebration. A calm and composed knock from him. But India need more from him.
Full and wide outside off, not much pace and bounce on this occasion, Pujara allows it through to the keeper.
Flighted ball on off, Nair presses forward and defends it to the off side.
A touch shortish this time, allowing the batsman to go back and work it on the leg side. It goes in the gap and they cross for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot by Pujara.
Floated full ball on middle, Pujara lunges and defends it back.
Loopy full ball on off, Che gets forward and pushes it to covers.
A little bit of movement back into the batsman from outside off, Nair stays back to defend but gets an inside edge. It rolls towards mid on. A wicket maiden for Pat!
Good lines from Cummins, keeping it fuller and around off, not allowing any width, Nair keeps it out off the bottom half of the bat.
Sharp delivery, very full and on off, Nair jams it out to mid off.
Attempts a yorker first up but ends up serving a low full toss around off, Karun pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Karun Nair is the next man in.

OUT! A poor shot attempted by Ajinkya Rahane and he has paid a big price for it. Cummins delivers a short ball outside off, Rahane tries to play the upper cut but ends up getting a faint tickle to the keeper. Wade catches the ball, they appeal and the finger goes up. A dejected Rahane walks back. India losing the plot, they still trail by 175 runs.
Lands it full and just around off, Rahane is solid in his front foot defense.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Four byes! SOK slips one down the leg side, the batsman fails to get any bat behind it and the keeper also fails to collect. It races behind for a boundary. 50-run partnership comes up.
Cheteshwar Pujara is closing in on a well-deserved century.
FOUR! Pujara is down the track in a flash again, takes it on the full and hits it firmly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Once again uses his feet to reach the pitch of the delivery and pushes it to mid off.
Walks down the track and defends it to the off side.
Floated full ball on off, Pujara defends it by getting forward.
Steven O'Keefe comes back for a bowl.
Pitches it full and outside off, Rahane takes his front leg and allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and on off, Rahane gets forward and defends it back with gentle hands.
Width on offer outside off, Pujara reaches out for it and runs it down to third man for a run.
Cummins bangs in a short ball on off, Rahane plays a controlled pull shot to deep backward square leg for a run.
Angles it in around off, Rahane defends it by getting forward.

Four byes! Cummins loses his radar and slips a full ball down the leg side, Rahane fails to flick and Wade fumbles while collecting the ball due to a bad bounce. It races through for a boundary at fine leg.
Physio comes out and is addressing the issue with Pujara's right hand.
Loopy and on middle, Rahane gets back and helps it through backward square leg for a run.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it gently.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning down leg, Pujara works it through backward square leg for a run.
Pujara dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Flatter ball on middle, staying low, Pujara goes back to defend and keeps it out on the leg side. Straightaway pulls out his bottom hand and looks in some pain.

Almost drags it on! Cummins lands it on a length and closer to the off stump line, Rahane tries to run it down but gets a bottom edge. It nearly went onto the stumps. Cummins almost starts to celebrate but then realizes it has not gone on the sticks.
Excellent delivery, spears in a very full ball on off, Rahane leans forward and across to keep it out towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, Rahane brings down a straight bat in defense.
Angling down the leg side, Pujara nudges it fine down the leg side for a run.
Back of a length ball around off, Pujara stays back and punches it through the gap at cover-point. Straightaway shouts "two" and completes it with ease.
Angles in a full ball on off, staying a touch low, Rahane closes the face of the bat and eases it to long leg for a run.
Pat Cummins replaces Josh Hazlewood.
Flighted ball on leg, Pujara gets back and nudges it through backward square leg for a run.
Loopy full ball on off, Rahane leans forward in defense.
Pushes it flatter and quicker on middle, Rahane gets back in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Allows the ball to spin back in and turns it through backward square leg for a run.
Walks down the track and pushes it to the right side of the bowler. Lyon parries it towards mid on. Jinx wanted a run but his partner was not interested.

FOUR! Not in control though. Josh digs in a short ball on middle, Rahane takes the challenge to pull it but fails to middle it. It flies off the top edge but there is no deep square leg in place. A boundary to Rahane's name. India have avoided the follow-on!
Full and just outside off, Ajinkya stays back and defends it towards gully.
Good length ball on off, Pujara eases himself on the back foot and punches it through the gap between mid off and extra cover for a run.
Angles in a shortish ball on middle, Rahane stands back and taps it behind square leg for one.
Back of a length ball on off, Pujara turns it off his hips through square leg and takes a run.
A bit too full around off, Pujara plays a neat flick shot through mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
Drinks have been taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Great shot by Jinx! Full floated ball on off, Rahane advances down the track and drills it through extra cover for a boundary.
Flighted ball on off, Pujara gets down the track and bunts it to mid on for a sharp single.
Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flicks it softly with the spin to the leg side, but finds the fielder.
EDGY FOUR! Tossed up ball outside off, Pujara tries to drive through covers but it catches the outside edge and runs down to third man for a boundary.
Nathan Lyon comes back for a bowl.
Excellent short ball, Rahane does well to evade it.
Lands it full and outside off, Rahane drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Fuller in length and on middle and leg, it's flicked through backward square leg for a run.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a length around off, Ajinkya defends it off his back foot.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
The point fielder drops back.

FOUR! Back of a length ball on off, Pujara leaps on the back foot and punches it to the left side of the point fielder. He dives but fails to stop the ball cleanly. It brushes his hands but still races behind for a boundary.
Pitches it full and outside off, Che gets forward in defense.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
FOUR! Wrong line by Cummins. Sharp delivery but angling down the leg side, Pujara just uses the pace and deflects it fine past the diving keeper for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Smart thinking from the bowler, after bowling full he decides to surprise the batsman with a bouncer, Rahane does well to sway away from the line.
Fuller and outside off, pushed with an angled bat to point.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Appeal for an lbw, turned down. Full and swinging into the batsman from around middle, Rahane fails to defend and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The bowler has a word with his keeper but they decide not to go for the DRS. Missing leg, maybe.
Fuller in length and outside off, left alone.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length ball on middle, shaping in, Rahane turns it to square leg for a run.
Ajinkya Rahane strolls out in the middle to replace Virat Kohli.

OUT! Edged and gone! Another failure in the series for Virat Kohli. Cummins hunts down the big fish. He serves a full length ball just around off and gets it to nip away a shade, Kohli without any footwork attempts for a booming cover drive but edges it straight into the hands of the Aussie skipper at second slip. He catches it in front of his face and gets up in jubilation. A bit of banter from the visitors, as Steven Smith holds his left shoulder to mock the Indian captain. Interestingly, if Maxwell hadn't stopped the boundary earlier, Pujara would've been on strike. Little moments in the game. New ball does the trick for Australia. Meanwhile, the umpires get involved to calm things down.

Nearly another boundary! Full in length around off, angling in, Pujara tickles it off his pads through mid-wicket and it races through. Maxwell and O'Keefe chase it and the former pulls it back with a dive. They've managed to run three. Maxwell while getting up holds his right shoulder, maybe trying to tease the Indian skipper.
FOUR! Nicely done! You cannot bowl a full toss on the pads. Pujara accepts the gift gleefully and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full in length around off, Pujara defends it by getting forward.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Second new ball has been immediately taken by Australia and the reviews have been reset.
Gets back and flicks it through the gap on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Once again excellent use of the feet by Pujara, he dances down the track to a full ball outside off and drills it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Leans forward to defend but it spins in to catch the inside edge. Goes uppishly but wide of short leg.
Full and flighted on off, whipped to short mid-wicket where the fielder only managed to take the pace off the ball. A single taken.
Full floated ball landing around leg, Kohli flicks it off his pads to backward square leg.
Flatter ball on middle, 92 kph, Virat gets back and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted and outside off, once again Pujara uses his pads as a shield and keeps it out.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it full on off, Pujara defends it by getting forward.
The batsman offers no stroke and keeps it out off his pads.
Pulls his length back a bit but persists with the line outside leg, Pujara goes back and helps it towards short leg.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Boring line from SOK, lands it full and outside leg, Pujara pads it away.
Probably a slider, landing full around middle and leg, Kohli closes the face of the bat a little early and keeps it out off a soft leading edge.
A touch short and outside off, Pujara gets back and taps it down through covers for one.
Loopy and on off, Pujara defends it back off his front foot.
Fuller and on off, defended off the inner half of the bat towards the fielder standing in front of square leg.
Flighted and full around off, Kohli gets forward and drives it to the left side of the mid off fielder. A quick single taken.
Quicker and fuller on middle, 94 kph, from around the wicket, Kohli gets back and defends it solidly.
Identical to the last delivery, Che can pad away those all day.
Tossed up ball landing outside leg, Pujara pads it away.
Pushes it full and on leg, Che defends it close to his front pad.
Lands it on a full length outside leg, Kohli gets back and turns it through the gap on the leg side for one.
Flighted on leg again, defended off the front foot by Virat.
Loopy and landing just outside leg, Kohli lunges and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Fullish and off, Kohli plays a wristy flick through mid-wicket for a run.

The second session of day 3 is about to begin. The Australian players are naturally pumped up, read Murali Vijay, and are taking their positions in the field. Virat Kohli will finally take the field and will be the new man in. Steve O'Keefe will finish his remaining over.

Hello and welcome to the third day of the third Test between India and Australia. The hosts have got what they just would have wanted, a solid start. Though they would be disheartened to lose KL Rahul's wicket, the experienced pair of Murali Vijay and Cheteshwar Pujara is at the crease. The home side's aim would be to bat out the whole day as Umesh Yadav pointed out yesterday that each session averages almost 100. Steven Smith's side, on the other hand, will try to make early inroads to put pressure on the hosts. Can India build on the solid platform or will Australia swing the pendulum into their side? Stay with us to find out......
...DAY 3, SESSION 1...

Australia's bowling was decent on an unresponsive pitch. Pat Cummins was the standout bowler for them, as he bowled his heart out and impressed with his pace and smart variations. Their spinners, however, failed to leave any impact and the visiting team will be hoping that they turn things around tomorrow. India still trail by a big margin and will have to continue batting well to narrow the gap. It promises to be an exciting day 3. Do join us at 0930 local (0400 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!
