OUT! Cummins strikes! Beautiful bowling. He bends his back and digs in a slower short ball, well-directed at the batsman, Rahul tries to sway away from the line of fire with a jump but it catches his gloves and goes safely to Wade. He catches it, Cummins turns to appeal and the finger goes up. KL starts to walk and Smith is hugging his bowler. Pat has bowled his heart out and finally gets some reward. Interestingly, Wade was not appealing. Anyway, Australia get the first breakthrough. India trail by 360 runs.
Full and angling back into the batsman, Rahul stays back and offers a straight bat in defense.
Flighted and around off, Murali defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning away with some extra bounce, Rahul goes back and turns it towards backward square leg. Wade quickly gets to the ball.
Another front foot defense by Rahul.
Full floated ball on off, KL defends it off his front foot.
Spears in a fuller length ball on middle and leg, Vijay tries to flick it but misses and it goes off his pads. Wade moves across to his left to collect the ball and they cross for a leg bye.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length delivery outside off, Vijay feels for it and gets beaten.
Angles in a full ball on off, Vijay blocks it safely on the leg side.
Good length ball on middle, Rahul glances it off his hips to deep backward square leg for a run.
Play and a miss! Cummins steams in and hurls across a short ball around off, Rahul needless pokes inside the line and nearly edges it to the keeper.
Loopy and around off, Murali drives it off his front foot to covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Pitches it very full on middle, Rahul forces it past the diving bowler for a run at long off.
Tickles it off his pads through mid-wicket and takes another couple of runs.
Full floated ball on off, KL draws forward and defends it to the off side.
Flatter ball on middle, KL goes back and turns it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Lovely variation, bowls it slower this time, 118 kph, full and around off, Vijay does well to keep it out as well.
Sharp delivery, hitting the blockhole, 148 kph, Vijay does well to dig it out.
Bouncer around off, MV sways away from the line.
Rahul plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length ball on off, Rahul defends it off his back foot.
Short and outside off, Rahul tries to force it through the line but gets a bottom edge.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it past the bowler to mid of for a single.
Full floated ball on off, blocked off the front foot again.
Rahul has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball on middle, Rahul gets forward and defends it back with a straight bat.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Arm ball on middle, skidding in, Vijay tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Another delivery in the zone outside off, Rahul shoulders arms to end the over.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Too full in length around off, KL drives it back to the bowler.
Looks to defend it from the crease but gets it away off the inside edge.
A touch short and around off, KL stands back and helps it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, staying a touch low, Vijay taps it down towards cover-point and crosses for a run.

Drinks break. It's been a good period of play for India as their openers are slowly getting used to the pitch. KL Rahul, in particular, has looked fluent from the outset and Murali Vijay has also eased into the supporting role for his partner. Australia will be hoping for a breakthrough in the next hour.
FOUR! Wrong line from Josh, slips a length ball down the leg side and Rahul does well to nudge it down towards fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, KL pushes it with an angled bat through point for a couple of runs.
Too full in length on off, an off cutter, flicked on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket. There are a couple of fielders in the catching position at mid-wicket.
Angles in a full ball on middle, KL brings a straight bat down and defends it to mid on.
Bowls it on a driving length and tries to tempt the batsman, KL however leaves it alone.
Fullish and on off, defended from the pads to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, flicked straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Cummins lets out a slower off cutter but fails to land it. It reaches as a full toss to the batsman and KL pushes it to cover-point for a run.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Rahul gets across and taps it down to mid-wicket.
Another full ball outside off, driven straight to the short cover fielder.
Fuller and on off, Rahul plays it off his pads towards mid on. Not from the middle of the bat.
Initiates his spell with a fast inswinger around off, it's full in length and Rahul defends it off his front foot.
Pat Cummins replaces Lyon in the attack. A wide slip and gully in place.
Lands it fuller and just outside off, Vijay brings down a straight bat in defense. He is looking at ease now after an initial struggle.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Angles a length ball into the batsman, Vijay keeps himself on the back foot and presents a straight bat in defense.
Bowls it wide of the crease and lands it on a fuller length outside off, straightening a touch, Vijay covers the line and shoulders arms.
Bouncer around middle and leg, angling down, Vijay sways away from the line.
Full and angling into the batsman, around off, Vijay flicks it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and around off, blocked safely off the back foot.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. No run.
5th Test fifty for KL Rahul!

FOUR! Reaches his fifty in style. Gets down on one knee to a full ball on middle and sweeps it with the spin to deep square leg for a boundary. He has batted confidently and has raced away to his half century. But now he needs to get his head down and aim for a big one.
Flighted and full outside off, Rahul defends it from the crease and it comes off the bottom half. It rolls behind and Wade removes the bail quickly after collecting the ball. No harm done.
Floated ball on middle, Vijay goes down on one knee and dinks it to fine leg for a run.
Loopy full ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Angles in a full ball on off, Rahul gets on the front foot and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and swinging into the batsman, KL does well to flick it through mid-wicket and returns for the second run.
EDGED AND FOUR! Hazlewood serves it on a good length outside off, Rahul feels for it, flat-footed and gets a big fat outside edge through the vacant second slip fielder for a boundary.
Another full ball swinging back into the batsman, this time Vijay plays a good looking flick but finds wide mid on.
Nicely played. Full and angling into the batsman, Vijay leans across, closes the face of the bat at the correct time and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Murali allows it through.
Lovely flight on this delivery, full and outside off, from over the wicket, Rahul lunges and defends it back.
A bit leg sidish from Nathan, Vijay nicely tucks it around the corner for one.
FOUR! Lyon goes quicker through the air and serves it outside off, Vijay plays it late and runs it off the outside half of the bat to third man for a boundary.
Loopy and full around off, Murali leans forward and defends it back with a straight bat.
Flighted and outside off, some extra bounce, KL does well to push it with an angled bat to cover-point. One run added to the total.
Tossed up ball on off, Rahul goes on the back foot and defends.
Outside off, left alone. Going has been good so far for India. The Australian bowlers, be it pacers or spinners, are not getting enough purchase from the pitch.
Goes fuller and gets the ball to swing back into the batsman, Murali defends it from the inner half of the bat.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Lovely boundary! Hazlewood overpitches outside off and Vijay cooks a brilliant cover drive for a boundary. This shot will give him a lot of confidence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Shout for an lbw! Full in length landing outside off, shaping in, Vijay gets forward with his bat behind his front pad. He is thudded on it, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Impact was outside off.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack.
Presses forward to a full ball and eases it down to long on for a run.
Spin and bounce into the batsman, Murali tries to work on the leg side but misses and takes a hit on the thigh pad.
Loopy full ball around off, Vijay gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Bowls it on the flatter trajectory around middle, Rahul works it through mid-wicket and crosses for a run. 50 up for India!
Slower through the air, a bit short and on middle, KL gets back to turn it off his pads and Handscomb does well at short leg to stop the ball.
Floated full ball on off, spinning in, Rahul draws forward and defends it to the off side.
Very full and on off, it's pushed through the gap at covers for one.
Flatter and a touch shorter on middle, KL gets back in defense.
Tossed up ball on off, defended.
Slower through the air and it hits the blockhole, Vijay squeezes it out and sends it past the bowler for a run at long off.
Floated and on off, defended back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
Lyon comes from around the wicket for the last delivery and bowls a full ball on off, Murali defends it watchfully.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Rahul eases it with soft hands to square leg and collects a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Vijay sweeps it through backward square leg for a run.
Floated full ball on off, Murali gets forward with a straight bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.
Loopy off spinner landing around off, it spins back in a touch as well, Vijay tries to sweep but fails to connect.
Full floated ball on off, KL lunges and defends it near his front pad. Compact.
Rahul is batting very confidently! Gets a short ball outside off and punches it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Deft touch! Arm ball landing on middle and skidding down, Rahul gets back and deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Loopy around off, it's quietly nudges through the right side of the square leg umpire for a run.
Full and around middle, Rahul turns it in front of square leg for a single.
Quicker full ball on off, Rahul defends it from the back foot.
Gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Very full in length around off, Rahul plays a premeditated sweep, fails to middle it and sends it somehow to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, Rahul covers the line and spin before defending it to the off side.
Floated off spinner this time, outside off, KL lunges and defends it off the inner half of the bat to the leg side.
Once again Lyon bowls it flat and quick around off, it's defended from the crease to the leg side.
Quicker off spinner landing a bit short outside off, Rahul goes back and punches it to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lands it full again and outside off, Murali drives but straight to covers again.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Floated again and full just outside off, it's left alone.
Floated full ball on off, MV defends it by getting forward.
Pushes it quicker through the air and lands it around off, Vijay gets back in defense.
Well played by Murali. He fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it gently to fine leg for a run.
Floated off spinner landing around off and turning back in, Rahul gets back and across to work it down to long leg for a run.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it with soft hands through mid on for a single.
Landing outside off and spinning in, Murali goes back and punches it to covers.
Throws it up full and outside off, spinning in a bit, Vijay leaves it alone.
A touch flatter and quicker on off, Vijay goes back and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Goes fuller and on off, Vijay drives it to mid off and rushes to the other end. Warner scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Murali is safely in.
A touch short and just outside off, Vijay goes on the back foot and punches it to short cover.
Arm ball landing full around off, KL lunges to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls through backward square leg for a run.
Flatter and very full on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Rahul has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

EDGY FOUR! O'Keefe gives it some extra air and lands it full outside off, spinning away a touch, Rahul reaches out for it as he tries to push through covers. It takes the outside edge and runs wide of first slip and backward point for a boundary.
This one is very full and around off, Vijay forces it down the ground to long on for a run.
Flighted full ball around off, Vijay kneels and sweeps it to long leg for one.
It has gone a bit overcast there.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Pulls his length back a shade and lands it on off, Vijay goes on the back foot and punches it towards short mid-wicket.
Loopy and full on off, once again Murali defends it by getting forward.
Flighted off spinner outside off, Vijay presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Spin from both ends after tea. Nathan Lyon to roll his arm. A slip and short leg in place.
Advances down the track to a full ball and flicks it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Once again O'Keefe pulls his length back and lands it around off, Rahul gets deep inside the crease and punches it sweetly through cover-point for a boundary.
Short this time, just outside off, Rahul goes back with the cut shot but finds the point fielder.
Tossed up and on off, once again defended off the front foot by Rahul.
Loopy and full on off, KL defends it by getting forward.
Flighted ball outside off, going straight on, Rahul gets forward to cover the line and shoulders arms.

We're back for the last session. The players are back on the field. 32 overs are still left in the day's play. India would like to see through this session without much hiccup. Steve O'Keefe to begin proceedings...
...DAY 2, SESSION 3...

India have seen off the tricky period after bundling out Australia. The openers played through the eight overs quite untroubled. The new ball is not doing much, which is a worrying factor for the visitors. An over of spin too was compensated efficiently. Nathan Lyon has still not bowled with the new cherry and it would be interesting to see how he bowls with it. Join us in a bit for the last session of day two.
Hurls a length ball, which swings away, Vijay lets it through. That will be tea on day two.
Shortish delivery, Lokesh gets over the ball and pushes it towards covers with soft hands. Single taken.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery outside off, Rahul waits for the ball to come to him and just guides it through point for another boundary. Two boundaries in the over, so far!
Back of a length delivery, Rahul leaves it alone.
Fuller delivery, outside off, Rahul looks to play the cover drive but it takes the inside edge and goes towards mid on.
FOUR! Lovely stroke from Rahul, pure timing. Cummins Serves a back of a length ball outside off, Rahul goes back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Loops this one around off, Vijay taps it to point.
Drags his length back and keeps it outside off, Rahul pats it towards covers for a run.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Rahul buries it onto the ground.
Bowls it slower through the air and around off, Rahul defends it solidly.
Fuller delivery on middle, Vijay knocks it down to long off for a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, bunted back to the bowler.
First bowling. Steve O'Keefe comes in for a bowl.
Another sharp delivery, on a length and around off, shaping back in, Rahul stays back footed and defends it to the off side.
Good line, full and around off, Rahul gets forward confidently and defends it close to his front pad.
Sharp delivery, on a length and angling down the leg side, KL allows it through again.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Bowls it in the corridor outside off, Rahul has nothing to do with it.

FOUR! First boundary of the Indian innings. Cummins spears in a full swinging delivery on middle, Rahul leans forward and across to flick it in front of square leg for a boundary. Not a bad ball but it was the sheer brilliance of the batsman. Some words exchanged between Cummins and Rahul.
A short leg in place.
Sprays it down the leg side, Vijay looks to get to it with a flick but the ball is out of his reach.
Short delivery, chest height, Rahul gets across and keeps the ball down with a pull. The ball goes towards deep fine leg. One run added to the total.
Lands this on a length, the ball comes in, but it is outside off and Rahul allows Wade to gather it.
Length ball outside off, Rahul pushes it towards the cover region.
Back of a length delivery around off, Rahul gets over the ball and buries it onto the ground.
Angles in a fuller length ball, it swings in, Rahul firmly blocks it.
Bouncer to end the over with, Vijay ducks under it.
Bowls it up and on the sixth stump line, gives Vijay no reason to play at it.
On a length, fourth stump line, Vijay knocks it back to Cummins.
Hits the deck hard, Rahul hops and defends it with soft hands towards square leg. Wade goes behind the cherry as the batsmen run through for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Rahul shoulders his arms.
On a length outside off, Rahul lets it through. It bounces well and Wade collects it near his head.
On a length outside off, Vijay knows where his off stump is and trusts his instincts before making a leave.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Rahul pats it to point and steals a run.
Shortish delivery, swinging in, Vijay pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery, fourth stump line, knocks it down the ground.
Beautiful delivery! Length ball, around off, Vijay goes forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Huge appeal for an LBW! Turned down and Australia don't opt for a review. Length ball which swings back in, Vijay looks to defend but gets beaten. The ball raps his pads, Josh goes up in a jiffy, but Ian Gould shakes his head. Thinks the height was the issue here.
Ends the over with fuller delivery around off, Rahul defends it off the front foot. Maiden over!
Good length delivery, outside off, Rahul allows it to go to the keeper.
Bowls a fuller delivery outside off, KL lunges and defends with an angled bat towards the leg side.
On a length outside off, Rahul leaves it alone. Wade fails to collect it but it doesn't result in any extra runs.
Fuller delivery, which swings in, Rahul comes forward and offers a front foot defense.
Starts with a full delivery on leg, Rahul dead-bats it towards the on side.
Pat Cummins will bowl from the other end. He is returning to Test cricket after a span of almost five years.
Bowls this very full and around off, Vijay knocks it back to the bowler. Sharp over from Josh Hazlewood to start off things for Australia.
Full ball, which swings in, Vijay leans forward to defend.
Angles in a fullish delivery, which nips back in, Vijay stands in his crease and blocks it.
Length ball, outside off, Vijay has decided to leave it alone.
On a length outside off, Vijay lets it through to the keeper.

Risky single to start with! India almost lost a wicket. Fuller delivery, which comes back in, Rahul defends it towards mid-wicket and looks for a quick single. Steve O'Keefe, positioned there, dives ahead and hurls a throw at non-striker's end. Had he hit, Rahul would've been in trouble! India need to be careful and avoid taking unnecessary risks.
